variants.title: NOT gate built from a NAND gate
variants.method: one NAND with its inputs joined
variants.unknown: the truth table of the NOT gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, one gate used
variants.note: A NAND with both inputs tied together gives A NAND A = A', the cheapest inverter there is.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations

variants.title: AND gate built from NAND gates
variants.method: a NAND followed by an inverting NAND
variants.unknown: the truth table of the AND gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, two gates used

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations

variants.title: OR gate built from NAND gates
variants.method: two inverters into a NAND (De Morgan)
variants.unknown: the truth table of the OR gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, three gates used
variants.note: A + B = (A'.B')' is De Morgan's theorem turned into wiring.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations

variants.title: XOR gate built from four NAND gates
variants.unknown: the truth table of the XOR gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, all four gates used
variants.note: One package is exactly enough: n1 = A NAND B, n2 = A NAND n1, n3 = B NAND n1, Y = n2 NAND n3.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations

variants.title: NOR gate built from NAND gates
variants.method: the OR network with an inverter on the output
variants.unknown: the truth table of the NOR gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, four gates used

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations

variants.title: XNOR gate built from NAND gates
variants.method: the XOR network with an inverter on the output
variants.unknown: the truth table of the XNOR gate
variants.sample: SN7400 quad 2-input NAND, five gates used (two packages)
variants.note: Five gates means a second package: the XOR network already uses all four of the first one.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, NAND-only realisations
